# Sensitivity analysis: attained age as the time scale (ELSA)
#   - Time scale: attained age in years, from calendar years. The ELSA End
#     User Licence files have no interview or birth month, so age at each
#     wave is wave year - birth year (birth_year in elsa_long.csv). For
#     people without a birth year (top-coded or missing indobyr) it is
#     baseline year - baseline age, then + years since baseline. Each interval
#     (tstart, tstop] becomes (age at the opening wave, age at the closing
#     wave], so entry is delayed to the age at baseline and every risk set
#     compares people of the same attained age. HRS uses age in months from
#     the interview dates.
#   - Baseline age is removed as a covariate (age is controlled by the
#     time scale).
#   - Everything else is unchanged: the same rows (tv_cc and the Model 5
#     data built from it), the same events, the same one-wave-lagged
#     exposures and covariates, robust (cluster) variance, Efron ties.
```{r}
# Models:
#   Model 2 (age scale): exposure only. On the age scale the exposure-only
#     model is already age-adjusted, so it is the counterpart of Model 2;
#     Model 1 (unadjusted for age) has no age-scale counterpart.
#   Model 3: + sex, race, education, marital status, employment, smoking,
#     alcohol.
#   Model 4: hearing / vision + frailty; frailty + hearing + vision.
#   Model 4 interaction: sensory x frailty (as Supplementary Table 34).
#   Model 5: three-level frailty-context exposure, Model 3 covariates.
# Proportional hazards: cox.zph(transform = "identity") tests whether each
# log-HR changes linearly with attained age; the plots show the estimated
# log-HR of the exposure as a function of age.

suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(dplyr); library(survival) })

age_print <- function(x, digits = 4)
  cat(capture.output(print(as.data.frame(x), row.names = FALSE,
                           digits = digits)), sep = "\n")

# ==========================================================================
# 1) Add the age time scale to an interval data set
# ==========================================================================
# One birth year per person, taken from the waves that report it. ELSA top-
# codes respondents aged 90+ (indager and indobyr = -7), so in those waves
# birth_year is NA and the age in elsa_long.csv is not a real age
# (imputed, or the code 99). The birth year from earlier waves gives the
# right calendar-year age for them. Fallback for people with no birth year
# in any wave (aged 90+ at baseline): baseline year - baseline age.
birth_tbl <- panel_df_eligible %>%
  transmute(idauniq = as.character(idauniq), birth_year = as.numeric(birth_year)) %>%
  group_by(idauniq) %>%
  summarise(n_by  = n_distinct(birth_year[!is.na(birth_year)]),
            by_el = if (all(is.na(birth_year))) NA_real_
                    else as.numeric(names(which.max(table(birth_year)))),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(baseline_df_eligible %>%
              transmute(idauniq = as.character(idauniq),
                        by_fb = as.numeric(year) - as.numeric(age)),
            by = "idauniq") %>%
  mutate(birth_year_used = coalesce(by_el, by_fb))
stopifnot(!anyNA(birth_tbl$birth_year_used))
cat(sprintf("Birth year: %d people | %d with >1 distinct birth_year across waves (most common used) | %d without birth_year (baseline year - baseline age used)\n",
            nrow(birth_tbl), sum(birth_tbl$n_by > 1), sum(is.na(birth_tbl$by_el))))
birth_tbl <- birth_tbl %>% dplyr::select(idauniq, birth_year_used)

# Adds age_in / age_out (years): calendar year of the opening / closing wave
# (baseline_year + tstart / tstop) - birth year.
add_age_scale <- function(dat, ts = "tstart", tp = "tstop", label = "") {
  d <- dat %>%
    mutate(idauniq = as.character(idauniq)) %>%
    left_join(birth_tbl, by = "idauniq") %>%
    mutate(age_in  = as.numeric(baseline_year) + .data[[ts]] - birth_year_used,
           age_out = as.numeric(baseline_year) + .data[[tp]] - birth_year_used) %>%
    dplyr::select(-birth_year_used)
  stopifnot(nrow(d) == nrow(dat))
  cat(sprintf("[%s] %d intervals | age at entry %.0f-%.0f | age at exit %.0f-%.0f\n",
              label, nrow(d), min(d$age_in), max(d$age_in),
              min(d$age_out), max(d$age_out)))
  stopifnot(!anyNA(d$age_in), all(d$age_out > d$age_in))
  d
}

# ==========================================================================
# 2) Build the age-scale data (same rows as the primary models)
# ==========================================================================
stopifnot(exists("tv_cc"), exists("df_tv_hearing"), exists("df_tv_vision"),
          exists("report_int"))

tv_age    <- add_age_scale(tv_cc,         label = "Models 2-4")
m5_age_h  <- add_age_scale(df_tv_hearing, label = "Model 5 hearing")
m5_age_v  <- add_age_scale(df_tv_vision,  label = "Model 5 vision")

# Check against the age reported at the closing wave, for waves with a
# reported birth year (top-coded 90+ waves have no real age to compare).
# The difference should be -1, 0 or 1: ELSA fieldwork for a wave runs into
# the next calendar year, and the interview can fall before or after the
# birthday.
age_reported <- panel_df_eligible %>%
  filter(!is.na(birth_year)) %>%
  transmute(idauniq = as.character(idauniq), .y1 = as.integer(year),
            age_rep = as.numeric(age)) %>%
  distinct(idauniq, .y1, .keep_all = TRUE)
age_chk <- tv_age %>%
  mutate(.y1 = as.integer(round(as.integer(baseline_year) + tstop))) %>%
  left_join(age_reported, by = c("idauniq", ".y1"))
stopifnot(nrow(age_chk) == nrow(tv_age))
age_diff <- age_chk$age_out - age_chk$age_rep
cat(sprintf("Age at exit (wave year - birth year) minus reported age: %.1f%% within 1 year | %d intervals beyond 1 year | %d closing waves top-coded (no reported birth year)\n",
            100 * mean(abs(age_diff) <= 1, na.rm = TRUE),
            sum(abs(age_diff) > 1, na.rm = TRUE), sum(is.na(age_diff))))
print(table(pmax(pmin(age_diff, 3), -3), useNA = "ifany", dnn = "difference (capped at +/-3)"))
cat(sprintf("Tied event ages: %d of %d events\n",
            sum(duplicated(tv_age$age_out[tv_age$event == 1])),
            sum(tv_age$event)))
rm(age_reported, age_chk, age_diff)


# ==========================================================================
# 3) Models on the age time scale
# ==========================================================================
# ---- Model 2 (age scale): exposure only ----
fit_a2_hearing <- coxph(Surv(age_in, age_out, event) ~ hearing_lag + cluster(idauniq),
                        data = tv_age, ties = "efron")
fit_a2_vision  <- coxph(Surv(age_in, age_out, event) ~ vision_lag + cluster(idauniq),
                        data = tv_age, ties = "efron")
fit_a2_frailty <- coxph(Surv(age_in, age_out, event) ~ frailty_lag + cluster(idauniq),
                        data = tv_age, ties = "efron")

# ---- Model 3: + sociodemographic and lifestyle (no baseline age) ----
fit_a3_hearing <- coxph(
  Surv(age_in, age_out, event) ~ hearing_lag +
    Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
    emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag + cluster(idauniq),
  data = tv_age, ties = "efron")
fit_a3_vision <- coxph(
  Surv(age_in, age_out, event) ~ vision_lag +
    Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
    emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag + cluster(idauniq),
  data = tv_age, ties = "efron")
fit_a3_frailty <- coxph(
  Surv(age_in, age_out, event) ~ frailty_lag +
    Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
    emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag + cluster(idauniq),
  data = tv_age, ties = "efron")

# ---- Model 4: hybrid, as in the primary analysis ----
fit_a4_hearing <- coxph(
  Surv(age_in, age_out, event) ~ hearing_lag +
    Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
    emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag + frailty_lag + cluster(idauniq),
  data = tv_age, ties = "efron")
fit_a4_vision <- coxph(
  Surv(age_in, age_out, event) ~ vision_lag +
    Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
    emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag + frailty_lag + cluster(idauniq),
  data = tv_age, ties = "efron")
fit_a4_frailty <- coxph(
  Surv(age_in, age_out, event) ~ hearing_lag + vision_lag + frailty_lag +
    Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
    emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag + cluster(idauniq),
  data = tv_age, ties = "efron")

# ---- Model 4 + sensory x frailty interaction ----
fit_a4_int_hearing <- coxph(
  Surv(age_in, age_out, event) ~ hearing_lag * frailty_lag +
    Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
    emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag + cluster(idauniq),
  data = tv_age, ties = "efron")
fit_a4_int_vision <- coxph(
  Surv(age_in, age_out, event) ~ vision_lag * frailty_lag +
    Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
    emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag + cluster(idauniq),
  data = tv_age, ties = "efron")

# ---- Model 5: frailty context, Model 3 covariates (no frailty term) ----
fit_a5_hearing <- coxph(
  Surv(age_in, age_out, dementia_event) ~ ctx_lag +
    Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
    emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag,
  data = m5_age_h, cluster = idauniq, ties = "efron", na.action = na.omit)
fit_a5_vision <- coxph(
  Surv(age_in, age_out, dementia_event) ~ ctx_lag +
    Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
    emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag,
  data = m5_age_v, cluster = idauniq, ties = "efron", na.action = na.omit)

age_fits <- list(
  M2_hearing = fit_a2_hearing, M2_vision = fit_a2_vision, M2_frailty = fit_a2_frailty,
  M3_hearing = fit_a3_hearing, M3_vision = fit_a3_vision, M3_frailty = fit_a3_frailty,
  M4_hearing = fit_a4_hearing, M4_vision = fit_a4_vision, M4_frailty = fit_a4_frailty,
  M4int_hearing = fit_a4_int_hearing, M4int_vision = fit_a4_int_vision,
  M5_hearing = fit_a5_hearing, M5_vision = fit_a5_vision)

# Same sample and events as the primary models
for (nm in names(age_fits)) {
  f <- age_fits[[nm]]
  stopifnot(f$n == nrow(tv_cc), f$nevent == sum(tv_cc$event))
}
cat("All age-scale fits:", nrow(tv_cc), "intervals,", sum(tv_cc$event),
    "events (identical to the primary models)\n")

# ==========================================================================
# 4) Hazard ratios: time on study (primary) vs attained age
# ==========================================================================
z975 <- qnorm(0.975)
lin_hr <- function(fit, w) {                 # w: named weights on coefficients
  b <- coef(fit); V <- vcov(fit)             # robust (cluster) variance
  est <- sum(w * b[names(w)])
  se  <- sqrt(drop(t(w) %*% V[names(w), names(w)] %*% w))
  c(HR = exp(est), lo = exp(est - z975 * se), hi = exp(est + z975 * se),
    p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(est / se)))
}
fmt_hr_p <- function(x)
  sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f); %s", x[["HR"]], x[["lo"]], x[["hi"]],
          if (x[["p"]] < 0.001) "P < 0.001" else sprintf("P = %.3f", x[["p"]]))

m5_terms <- function(fit) {
  nm <- names(coef(fit))
  c(before = grep("no frailty yet",  nm, fixed = TRUE, value = TRUE),
    after  = grep("frailty present", nm, fixed = TRUE, value = TRUE))
}

# rows: model, exposure, primary fit, age-scale fit, weights builder
cmp_rows <- list(
  list("Model 2", "Hearing impairment", fit_m2_hearing, fit_a2_hearing, function(f) c(hearing_lag = 1)),
  list("Model 2", "Vision impairment",  fit_m2_vision,  fit_a2_vision,  function(f) c(vision_lag = 1)),
  list("Model 2", "Frailty",            fit_m2_frailty, fit_a2_frailty, function(f) c(frailty_lag = 1)),
  list("Model 3", "Hearing impairment", fit_m3_hearing, fit_a3_hearing, function(f) c(hearing_lag = 1)),
  list("Model 3", "Vision impairment",  fit_m3_vision,  fit_a3_vision,  function(f) c(vision_lag = 1)),
  list("Model 3", "Frailty",            fit_m3_frailty, fit_a3_frailty, function(f) c(frailty_lag = 1)),
  list("Model 4", "Hearing impairment", fit_m4_hearing, fit_a4_hearing, function(f) c(hearing_lag = 1)),
  list("Model 4", "Vision impairment",  fit_m4_vision,  fit_a4_vision,  function(f) c(vision_lag = 1)),
  list("Model 4", "Frailty",            fit_m4_frailty, fit_a4_frailty, function(f) c(frailty_lag = 1)),
  list("Model 4 interaction", "Hearing, non-frail", fit_m4_int_hearing, fit_a4_int_hearing,
       function(f) c(hearing_lag = 1)),
  list("Model 4 interaction", "Hearing, frail", fit_m4_int_hearing, fit_a4_int_hearing,
       function(f) c(hearing_lag = 1, "hearing_lag:frailty_lag" = 1)),
  list("Model 4 interaction", "Hearing x frailty (ratio of HRs)", fit_m4_int_hearing, fit_a4_int_hearing,
       function(f) c("hearing_lag:frailty_lag" = 1)),
  list("Model 4 interaction", "Vision, non-frail", fit_m4_int_vision, fit_a4_int_vision,
       function(f) c(vision_lag = 1)),
  list("Model 4 interaction", "Vision, frail", fit_m4_int_vision, fit_a4_int_vision,
       function(f) c(vision_lag = 1, "vision_lag:frailty_lag" = 1)),
  list("Model 4 interaction", "Vision x frailty (ratio of HRs)", fit_m4_int_vision, fit_a4_int_vision,
       function(f) c("vision_lag:frailty_lag" = 1)),
  list("Model 5", "Hearing, before frailty onset", fit_m5_hearing, fit_a5_hearing,
       function(f) setNames(1, m5_terms(f)[["before"]])),
  list("Model 5", "Hearing, with or after frailty onset", fit_m5_hearing, fit_a5_hearing,
       function(f) setNames(1, m5_terms(f)[["after"]])),
  list("Model 5", "Hearing, with or after / before", fit_m5_hearing, fit_a5_hearing,
       function(f) setNames(c(1, -1), m5_terms(f)[c("after", "before")])),
  list("Model 5", "Vision, before frailty onset", fit_m5_vision, fit_a5_vision,
       function(f) setNames(1, m5_terms(f)[["before"]])),
  list("Model 5", "Vision, with or after frailty onset", fit_m5_vision, fit_a5_vision,
       function(f) setNames(1, m5_terms(f)[["after"]])),
  list("Model 5", "Vision, with or after / before", fit_m5_vision, fit_a5_vision,
       function(f) setNames(c(1, -1), m5_terms(f)[c("after", "before")]))
)

hr_compare <- bind_rows(lapply(cmp_rows, function(r) {
  p <- lin_hr(r[[3]], r[[5]](r[[3]]))
  a <- lin_hr(r[[4]], r[[5]](r[[4]]))
  tibble(model = r[[1]], exposure = r[[2]],
         HR_time_on_study = fmt_hr_p(p), HR_attained_age = fmt_hr_p(a),
         HR_tos = p[["HR"]], HR_age = a[["HR"]])
}))

cat("\n=== Hazard ratios: time since baseline (primary) vs attained age ===\n")
cat("  Primary: time since baseline, adjusted for baseline age.\n")
cat("  Attained age: age time scale with delayed entry, no age covariate.\n")
age_print(hr_compare %>% dplyr::select(model, exposure, HR_time_on_study, HR_attained_age))

# Interaction and RERI on the age scale, in the same format as Supplementary Table 34
int_age_hearing <- report_int(fit_a4_int_hearing, "hearing_lag", "AGE SCALE: HEARING x FRAILTY")
int_age_vision  <- report_int(fit_a4_int_vision,  "vision_lag",  "AGE SCALE: VISION x FRAILTY")

# ==========================================================================
# 5) Proportional hazards on the age scale: do the HRs vary with age?
# ==========================================================================
# transform = "identity": the test is for a linear trend of each log-HR in
# attained age. A small P means the HR changes with age; the plot shows how.
exposure_terms <- function(nm, fit) {
  co <- names(coef(fit))
  if (grepl("^M5", nm)) return(m5_terms(fit))
  if (grepl("^M4int", nm)) return(grep("(hearing|vision)_lag(:frailty_lag)?$", co, value = TRUE))
  ex <- sub("^M[0-9]_", "", nm)
  paste0(ex, "_lag")
}

zph_age <- lapply(names(age_fits), function(nm) {
  f <- age_fits[[nm]]
  z <- cox.zph(f, transform = "identity", terms = FALSE)
  tab <- z$table
  terms <- exposure_terms(nm, f)
  tibble(fit = nm, term = c(terms, "GLOBAL"),
         chisq = tab[c(terms, "GLOBAL"), "chisq"],
         df = tab[c(terms, "GLOBAL"), "df"],
         p = tab[c(terms, "GLOBAL"), "p"]) %>%
    mutate(zph = list(z))
})
zph_tab <- bind_rows(zph_age)

cat("\n=== Proportional hazards on the age time scale (cox.zph, transform = identity) ===\n")
cat("  Exposure terms and global test; P < 0.05 = HR changes with attained age\n")
age_print(zph_tab %>% dplyr::select(fit, term, chisq, df, p) %>%
            mutate(p = signif(p, 3), chisq = round(chisq, 2)))

# Estimated log-HR of each exposure term as a function of attained age.
# The dashed line is the constant (proportional-hazards) estimate.
for (i in seq_len(nrow(zph_tab))) {
  if (zph_tab$term[i] == "GLOBAL") next
  z  <- zph_tab$zph[[i]]
  tm <- zph_tab$term[i]
  j  <- match(tm, colnames(z$y))
  if (is.na(j)) next
  plot(z[j], resid = FALSE, se = TRUE, xlab = "Attained age (years)",
       ylab = "log hazard ratio",
       main = sprintf("%s: %s (PH test P = %.3f)", zph_tab$fit[i], tm, zph_tab$p[i]))
  abline(h = coef(age_fits[[zph_tab$fit[i]]])[tm], lty = 2, col = "grey40")
}

```


# Sensitivity analysis: Levin PAFs from the attained-age HRs (ELSA), Models 2-5
```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(dplyr); library(tibble) })

stopifnot(exists("tv_cc"), exists("df_tv_hearing"), exists("df_tv_vision"),
          exists("fit_a2_hearing"), exists("fit_a5_vision"),
          exists("fit_m2_hearing"), exists("fit_m5_vision"))

if (!exists("age_print"))                    # defined in the attained-age chunk
  age_print <- function(x, digits = 4)
    cat(capture.output(print(as.data.frame(x), row.names = FALSE,
                             digits = digits)), sep = "\n")

AGE_PAF_SEED <- if (exists("PAF_SEED")) PAF_SEED else 20260509
AGE_PAF_NSIM <- if (exists("PAF_NSIM")) PAF_NSIM else 10000

# ---- Helpers (copies of the primary PAF chunk, renamed) --------------------
age_levin <- function(p, HR) (p * (HR - 1)) / (p * (HR - 1) + 1)

age_prev_binary <- function(dat, var, ts, tp) {
  pt <- dat[[tp]] - dat[[ts]]
  x  <- dat[[var]]
  sum(pt[x == 1], na.rm = TRUE) / sum(pt, na.rm = TRUE)
}

age_prev_factor <- function(dat, var, ts, tp) {
  pt    <- dat[[tp]] - dat[[ts]]
  x     <- dat[[var]]
  total <- sum(pt, na.rm = TRUE)
  setNames(vapply(levels(x), function(lv) sum(pt[x == lv], na.rm = TRUE) / total,
                  numeric(1)), levels(x))
}

age_paf_binary <- function(fit, term, p, nsim = AGE_PAF_NSIM, seed = AGE_PAF_SEED) {
  b <- unname(coef(fit)[term])
  V <- vcov(fit)[term, term]                 # robust (cluster) variance
  stopifnot(!is.na(b), V > 0)
  set.seed(seed)
  pafs <- age_levin(p, exp(rnorm(nsim, mean = b, sd = sqrt(V))))
  tibble(HR     = exp(b),
         HR_lcl = exp(b - qnorm(0.975) * sqrt(V)),
         HR_ucl = exp(b + qnorm(0.975) * sqrt(V)),
         PAF     = age_levin(p, exp(b)),
         PAF_lcl = unname(quantile(pafs, 0.025)),
         PAF_ucl = unname(quantile(pafs, 0.975)))
}

age_paf_multicat <- function(fit, terms, p_vec, labels,
                             nsim = AGE_PAF_NSIM, seed = AGE_PAF_SEED) {
  b <- unname(coef(fit)[terms])
  V <- vcov(fit)[terms, terms, drop = FALSE]
  set.seed(seed)
  sims <- MASS::mvrnorm(nsim, mu = b, Sigma = V)
  if (is.vector(sims)) sims <- matrix(sims, ncol = length(terms))

  comp_sim  <- sweep(exp(sims) - 1, 2, p_vec, `*`)
  s_sim     <- rowSums(comp_sim)
  comp_est  <- p_vec * (exp(b) - 1)
  s_est     <- sum(comp_est)
  se        <- sqrt(diag(V))
  q <- function(x, pr) unname(quantile(x, pr))

  tibble(exposure = c("Total", labels),
         HR       = c(NA_real_, exp(b)),
         HR_lcl   = c(NA_real_, exp(b - qnorm(0.975) * se)),
         HR_ucl   = c(NA_real_, exp(b + qnorm(0.975) * se)),
         PAF      = c(s_est / (1 + s_est), comp_est / (1 + s_est)),
         PAF_lcl  = c(q(s_sim / (1 + s_sim), 0.025),
                      apply(comp_sim / (1 + s_sim), 2, q, 0.025)),
         PAF_ucl  = c(q(s_sim / (1 + s_sim), 0.975),
                      apply(comp_sim / (1 + s_sim), 2, q, 0.975)))
}

# ==========================================================================
# 1) Prevalences (primary data, primary time scale)
# ==========================================================================
for (f in list(fit_a2_hearing, fit_a3_vision, fit_a4_frailty, fit_a5_hearing, fit_a5_vision))
  stopifnot(f$n == nrow(tv_cc))
stopifnot(nrow(df_tv_hearing) == nrow(tv_cc), nrow(df_tv_vision) == nrow(tv_cc))

age_p <- c(
  hearing = age_prev_binary(tv_cc, "hearing_lag", "tstart", "tstop"),
  vision  = age_prev_binary(tv_cc, "vision_lag",  "tstart", "tstop"),
  frailty = age_prev_binary(tv_cc, "frailty_lag", "tstart", "tstop"))

cat("Person-time-weighted prevalence (tv_cc), used for both time scales:\n")
cat(sprintf("  %-8s %.4f\n", names(age_p), age_p), sep = "")

# For information only: the same prevalence weighted by person-time on the
# age scale (age_out - age_in). Not used; it should differ only slightly.
if (exists("tv_age")) {
  p_agept <- c(hearing = age_prev_binary(tv_age, "hearing_lag", "age_in", "age_out"),
               vision  = age_prev_binary(tv_age, "vision_lag",  "age_in", "age_out"),
               frailty = age_prev_binary(tv_age, "frailty_lag", "age_in", "age_out"))
  cat("  (weighted by age-scale person-time instead:",
      paste(sprintf("%s %.4f", names(p_agept), p_agept), collapse = ", "), ")\n")
}

# ==========================================================================
# 2) PAFs, Models 2-4: primary fit and age-scale fit, same p
# ==========================================================================
# Model labels and exposure names follow paf_all, so the two tables line up.
age_spec_14 <- tribble(
  ~model,                                 ~exposure,      ~term,         ~p_key,    ~fit_tos,         ~fit_age,
  "M2 (+ age)",                           "Hearing loss", "hearing_lag", "hearing", "fit_m2_hearing", "fit_a2_hearing",
  "M2 (+ age)",                           "Vision loss",  "vision_lag",  "vision",  "fit_m2_vision",  "fit_a2_vision",
  "M2 (+ age)",                           "Frailty",      "frailty_lag", "frailty", "fit_m2_frailty", "fit_a2_frailty",
  "M3 (+ sociodemographic + lifestyle)",  "Hearing loss", "hearing_lag", "hearing", "fit_m3_hearing", "fit_a3_hearing",
  "M3 (+ sociodemographic + lifestyle)",  "Vision loss",  "vision_lag",  "vision",  "fit_m3_vision",  "fit_a3_vision",
  "M3 (+ sociodemographic + lifestyle)",  "Frailty",      "frailty_lag", "frailty", "fit_m3_frailty", "fit_a3_frailty",
  "M4 (hybrid, frailty-adj)",             "Hearing loss", "hearing_lag", "hearing", "fit_m4_hearing", "fit_a4_hearing",
  "M4 (hybrid, frailty-adj)",             "Vision loss",  "vision_lag",  "vision",  "fit_m4_vision",  "fit_a4_vision",
  "M4 (mutually adjusted)",               "Frailty",      "frailty_lag", "frailty", "fit_m4_frailty", "fit_a4_frailty"
)

age_paf_14 <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(age_spec_14)), function(i) {
  s <- age_spec_14[i, ]
  p <- age_p[[s$p_key]]
  bind_rows(
    tibble(scale = "time_since_baseline", model = s$model, exposure = s$exposure, p_pt = p) %>%
      bind_cols(age_paf_binary(get(s$fit_tos), s$term, p)),
    tibble(scale = "attained_age", model = s$model, exposure = s$exposure, p_pt = p) %>%
      bind_cols(age_paf_binary(get(s$fit_age), s$term, p)))
}))

# ==========================================================================
# 3) PAFs, Model 5: three-level context, primary fit and age-scale fit
# ==========================================================================
# Prevalence of each context level from the primary Model 5 data (start/stop);
# the age-scale data have the same rows and the same ctx_lag.
age_paf_m5 <- function(fit_tos, fit_age, dat, model_label) {
  stopifnot(is.factor(dat$ctx_lag), fit_age$n == nrow(dat))
  lv    <- levels(dat$ctx_lag)[-1]
  p_vec <- age_prev_factor(dat, "ctx_lag", "start", "stop")[lv]
  terms <- paste0("ctx_lag", lv)
  stopifnot(all(terms %in% names(coef(fit_tos))), all(terms %in% names(coef(fit_age))))

  one <- function(fit, scale) {
    tab <- age_paf_multicat(fit, terms, p_vec, lv)
    stopifnot(abs(sum(tab$PAF[-1]) - tab$PAF[1]) < 1e-10)   # components add up
    tibble(scale = scale, model = model_label) %>%
      bind_cols(tab) %>%
      mutate(p_pt = c(sum(p_vec), unname(p_vec)), .after = exposure)
  }
  bind_rows(one(fit_tos, "time_since_baseline"), one(fit_age, "attained_age"))
}

age_paf_5 <- bind_rows(
  age_paf_m5(fit_m5_hearing, fit_a5_hearing, df_tv_hearing, "M5 (hearing context)"),
  age_paf_m5(fit_m5_vision,  fit_a5_vision,  df_tv_vision,  "M5 (vision context)"))

age_paf_long <- bind_rows(age_paf_14, age_paf_5)

# The time-since-baseline rows reproduce the primary PAF table exactly
# (same fits, p, seed and draws), which checks that the helpers match.
if (exists("paf_all")) {
  chk <- age_paf_long %>%
    filter(scale == "time_since_baseline") %>%
    inner_join(paf_all %>% dplyr::select(model, exposure, PAF_primary = PAF,
                                         lcl_primary = PAF_lcl),
               by = c("model", "exposure"))
  stopifnot(nrow(chk) == nrow(age_paf_long) / 2,
            max(abs(chk$PAF - chk$PAF_primary)) < 1e-8,
            max(abs(chk$PAF_lcl - chk$lcl_primary)) < 1e-8)
  cat("\nCheck: time-since-baseline PAFs match the primary PAF table (paf_all).\n")
}

# ==========================================================================
# 4) Side-by-side table
# ==========================================================================
age_fmt_hr  <- function(est, lo, hi)
  ifelse(is.na(est), "", sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", est, lo, hi))
age_fmt_pct <- function(est, lo, hi) {
  r <- function(x) round(100 * x, 1) + 0      # + 0 avoids printing "-0.0"
  sprintf("%.1f (%.1f to %.1f)", r(est), r(lo), r(hi))
}

# Short model names for printing
age_short_model <- function(x)
  case_when(x == "M4 (mutually adjusted)" ~ "M4 (mutual)",
            x == "M5 (hearing context)"   ~ "M5 hearing",
            x == "M5 (vision context)"    ~ "M5 vision",
            TRUE ~ sub(" .*$", "", x))

# Model 5 rows: readable names for the two context levels
age_m5_label <- function(x)
  case_when(grepl("no frailty yet",  x, fixed = TRUE) ~ "Before frailty onset",
            grepl("frailty present", x, fixed = TRUE) ~ "With or after frailty onset",
            TRUE ~ x)

paf_age_compare <- age_paf_long %>%
  mutate(HR_CI  = age_fmt_hr(HR, HR_lcl, HR_ucl),
         PAF_CI = age_fmt_pct(PAF, PAF_lcl, PAF_ucl)) %>%
  dplyr::select(scale, model, exposure, p_pt, HR, PAF, HR_CI, PAF_CI) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = scale, values_from = c(HR, PAF, HR_CI, PAF_CI)) %>%
  mutate(exposure = age_m5_label(exposure),
         PAF_diff_points = 100 * (PAF_attained_age - PAF_time_since_baseline))

cat("\n=== Levin PAF: time since baseline (primary) vs attained age, Models 2-5 ===\n")
cat("  Same person-time prevalence p for both; only the HR differs.\n")
cat("  Model 5: components add up to the total; a component is negative when its HR < 1.\n")
age_print(paf_age_compare %>%
            transmute(model = age_short_model(model), exposure, p = round(p_pt, 3),
                      HR_primary  = HR_CI_time_since_baseline,

                      HR_age      = HR_CI_attained_age,
                      PAF_age     = PAF_CI_attained_age,
                      diff_pts    = round(PAF_diff_points, 1)))

# HRs as numbers (both time scales), same rows as hr_compare
```

# Subgroup analysis by baseline age and sex (ELSA)
```{r}
library(survival); library(dplyr); library(purrr); library(tibble); library(tidyr)

stopifnot(exists("tv_cc"), exists("df_tv_hearing"), exists("df_tv_vision"),
          exists("fit_m4_hearing"), exists("fit_m5_hearing"))

add_subgroup_factors <- function(d) {
  d %>% mutate(
    age_cat = factor(if_else(as.numeric(baseline_age) < 65, "<65", "≥65"),
                     levels = c("<65", "≥65")),
    sex_cat = factor(case_when(
      as.character(Gender) %in% c("1","Male","male","M")     ~ "Male",
      as.character(Gender) %in% c("2","Female","female","F") ~ "Female"
    ), levels = c("Male","Female"))
  )
}
tv_cc         <- add_subgroup_factors(tv_cc)
df_tv_hearing <- add_subgroup_factors(df_tv_hearing)
df_tv_vision  <- add_subgroup_factors(df_tv_vision)

# Every interval must fall in exactly one stratum of each subgrouping
for (d in list(tv_cc, df_tv_hearing, df_tv_vision))
  stopifnot(!anyNA(d$age_cat), !anyNA(d$sex_cat))

subgroup_specs <- tribble(~label,~var,
                          "Age at baseline","age_cat",
                          "Sex","sex_cat")
# Covariate dropped within each stratum: only one that is constant there.
# Age strata keep baseline_age (age still varies within <65 and >=65).
drop_in_strata <- c(age_cat = NA_character_, sex_cat = "Gender")
base_covs <- c("baseline_age","Gender","Race","Education","Marital_status",
               "emp_lag","smoke_lag","alcohol_lag")
tv_time <- c("tstart","tstop","event")
m5_time <- c("start","stop","dementia_event")

fit_cox <- function(data, rhs_terms, time_vars) {
  fml <- reformulate(rhs_terms,
                     response = sprintf("Surv(%s, %s, %s)",
                                        time_vars[1], time_vars[2], time_vars[3]))
  tryCatch(coxph(fml, data = data, cluster = idauniq,
                 ties = "efron", na.action = na.omit),
           error = function(e) {
             warning("Cox fit failed (", deparse(fml, width.cutoff = 500L), "): ",
                     conditionMessage(e), call. = FALSE)
             NULL
           })
}

# Model 5 terms, found by name
m5_term <- function(fit, which = c("before", "after")) {
  which <- match.arg(which)
  pat <- if (which == "before") "no frailty yet" else "frailty present"
  nm  <- names(coef(fit))
  hit <- nm[startsWith(nm, "ctx_lag") & !grepl(":", nm, fixed = TRUE) &
              grepl(pat, nm, fixed = TRUE)]
  if (length(hit) == 1) hit else NA_character_
}

# Same specification as the primary models, checked on the full sample
chk_m4 <- fit_cox(tv_cc, c("hearing_lag", base_covs, "frailty_lag"), tv_time)
chk_m5 <- fit_cox(df_tv_hearing, c("ctx_lag", base_covs), m5_time)
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(coef(chk_m4)[["hearing_lag"]],
                           coef(fit_m4_hearing)[["hearing_lag"]], tolerance = 1e-8)),
          isTRUE(all.equal(unname(coef(chk_m5)[m5_term(chk_m5, "after")]),
                           unname(coef(fit_m5_hearing)[m5_term(fit_m5_hearing, "after")]),
                           tolerance = 1e-8)))
cat("Check: unstratified refits reproduce the primary Model 4 and Model 5 estimates.\n")
rm(chk_m4, chk_m5)

# Exposure x subgroup interaction: pooled model with the same covariates,
# joint robust Wald test of all product terms (1 df; 2 df for Model 5)
p_interaction <- function(data, exposure, gv, extra_rhs, time_vars) {
  cv  <- setdiff(c(base_covs, extra_rhs), drop_in_strata[[gv]])
  rhs <- unique(c(paste0(exposure," * ",gv), cv))
  fit <- fit_cox(data, rhs, time_vars); if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)
  nm <- names(coef(fit))
  ix <- which(grepl(":", nm, fixed = TRUE) & startsWith(nm, exposure) &
                grepl(gv, nm, fixed = TRUE))
  if (!length(ix)) return(NA_real_)
  b <- coef(fit)[ix]; V <- vcov(fit)[ix, ix, drop = FALSE]
  pchisq(as.numeric(t(b) %*% solve(V) %*% b), df = length(ix), lower.tail = FALSE)
}

run_m4_binary <- function(data, exposure, time_vars, extra_rhs) {
  map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(subgroup_specs)), function(k) {
    g <- subgroup_specs$label[k]; gv <- subgroup_specs$var[k]
    pi <- p_interaction(data, exposure, gv, extra_rhs, time_vars)
    map_dfr(levels(droplevels(data[[gv]])), function(lv) {
      sub <- data %>% filter(.data[[gv]] == lv)
      cv  <- setdiff(c(base_covs, extra_rhs), drop_in_strata[[gv]])
      fit <- fit_cox(sub, unique(c(exposure, cv)), time_vars)
      if (is.null(fit) || !(exposure %in% names(coef(fit))))
        return(tibble(group=g, stratum=lv, n_int=nrow(sub),
                      n_ev=sum(sub[[time_vars[3]]]==1, na.rm=TRUE),
                      HR=NA_real_, lo=NA_real_, hi=NA_real_, p_int=pi))
      cf <- summary(fit)$conf.int
      tibble(group=g, stratum=lv, n_int=fit$n, n_ev=fit$nevent,
             HR=cf[exposure,1], lo=cf[exposure,3], hi=cf[exposure,4], p_int=pi)
    })
  }) %>% group_by(group) %>%
    mutate(p_int=if_else(row_number()==1, p_int, NA_real_)) %>% ungroup()
}
run_m4_frailty <- function(data, time_vars)
  run_m4_binary(data, "frailty_lag", time_vars,
                extra_rhs = c("hearing_lag","vision_lag"))

run_m5 <- function(data, time_vars = m5_time) {
  exposure <- "ctx_lag"
  map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(subgroup_specs)), function(k) {
    g <- subgroup_specs$label[k]; gv <- subgroup_specs$var[k]
    pi <- p_interaction(data, exposure, gv, NULL, time_vars)
    map_dfr(levels(droplevels(data[[gv]])), function(lv) {
      sub <- data %>% filter(.data[[gv]] == lv)
      sub[[exposure]] <- droplevels(sub[[exposure]])
      cv <- setdiff(base_covs, drop_in_strata[[gv]])
      fit <- fit_cox(sub, c(exposure, cv), time_vars)
      out <- tibble(group=g, stratum=lv,
                    n_int=if (is.null(fit)) nrow(sub) else fit$n,
                    n_ev =if (is.null(fit))
                      sum(sub[[time_vars[3]]]==1, na.rm=TRUE) else fit$nevent,
                    HR_1=NA_real_,lo_1=NA_real_,hi_1=NA_real_,
                    HR_2=NA_real_,lo_2=NA_real_,hi_2=NA_real_, p_int=pi)
      if (!is.null(fit)) {
        cf <- summary(fit)$conf.int
        t1 <- m5_term(fit, "before"); t2 <- m5_term(fit, "after")
        if (!is.na(t1)) { out$HR_1 <- cf[t1,1]; out$lo_1 <- cf[t1,3]; out$hi_1 <- cf[t1,4] }
        if (!is.na(t2)) { out$HR_2 <- cf[t2,1]; out$lo_2 <- cf[t2,3]; out$hi_2 <- cf[t2,4] }
      }
      out
    })
  }) %>% group_by(group) %>%
    mutate(p_int=if_else(row_number()==1, p_int, NA_real_)) %>% ungroup()
}

res_m4_hearing <- run_m4_binary(tv_cc, "hearing_lag", tv_time, extra_rhs="frailty_lag")
res_m4_vision  <- run_m4_binary(tv_cc, "vision_lag",  tv_time, extra_rhs="frailty_lag")
res_m4_frailty <- run_m4_frailty(tv_cc, tv_time)
res_m5_hearing <- run_m5(df_tv_hearing)
res_m5_vision  <- run_m5(df_tv_vision)

# Sanity check: within each subgrouping, the strata add up to the full sample
chk_strata <- function(res, dat, ev, label) {
  tot <- res %>% group_by(group) %>%
    summarise(n_int = sum(n_int), n_ev = sum(n_ev), .groups = "drop")
  stopifnot(all(tot$n_int == nrow(dat)), all(tot$n_ev == sum(dat[[ev]])))
  cat(sprintf("Check [%s]: strata add up to %d intervals and %d events\n",
              label, nrow(dat), sum(dat[[ev]])))
}
chk_strata(res_m4_hearing, tv_cc, "event", "M4 hearing")
chk_strata(res_m4_vision,  tv_cc, "event", "M4 vision")
chk_strata(res_m4_frailty, tv_cc, "event", "M4 frailty")
chk_strata(res_m5_hearing, df_tv_hearing, "dementia_event", "M5 hearing")
chk_strata(res_m5_vision,  df_tv_vision,  "dementia_event", "M5 vision")

```


# Calculate PAF for subgroup analysis
```{r}
# Subgroup PAF — Models 1-5 (ELSA, dementia outcome)
# For every subgroup level we:
#   (1) subset the analytic dataset to that stratum,
#   (2) refit the model on that stratum (dropping the stratifier from RHS),
#   (3) recompute person-time-weighted exposure prevalence in that stratum,
#   (4) compute PAF (+ 95% CI via parametric bootstrap on log-HR).
#
# Dependencies expected in the environment:
#   tv_cc, df_tv_hearing, df_tv_vision (already augmented with
#   age_cat / sex_cat by add_subgroup_factors above).
# ============================================================================

library(survival); library(dplyr); library(purrr); library(tibble); library(tidyr)
set.seed(20260509)

stopifnot(exists("res_m4_hearing"), "age_cat" %in% names(tv_cc))

SG_SEED <- if (exists("PAF_SEED")) PAF_SEED else 20260509
SG_NSIM <- if (exists("PAF_NSIM")) PAF_NSIM else 10000

# ---- PAF helpers (own names, so the primary helpers stay intact) -----------
sg_levin <- function(p, HR) (p * (HR - 1)) / (p * (HR - 1) + 1)

sg_paf_ci_binary <- function(fit, term, p, nsim = SG_NSIM, seed = SG_SEED) {
  b <- unname(coef(fit)[term])
  V <- vcov(fit)[term, term]                 # robust (cluster) variance
  if (is.na(b) || !is.finite(V) || V <= 0)
    return(tibble(HR = NA_real_, PAF = NA_real_, lcl = NA_real_, ucl = NA_real_))
  set.seed(seed)
  pafs <- sg_levin(p, exp(rnorm(nsim, mean = b, sd = sqrt(V))))
  tibble(HR  = exp(b),
         PAF = sg_levin(p, exp(b)),
         lcl = unname(quantile(pafs, 0.025)),
         ucl = unname(quantile(pafs, 0.975)))
}

sg_paf_ci_multicat <- function(fit, terms, p_vec, labels,
                               nsim = SG_NSIM, seed = SG_SEED) {
  b <- unname(coef(fit)[terms])
  V <- vcov(fit)[terms, terms, drop = FALSE]
  if (any(is.na(b)) || any(!is.finite(diag(V))))
    return(tibble(component = c("Total", labels),
                  HR  = NA_real_, PAF = NA_real_, lcl = NA_real_, ucl = NA_real_))
  set.seed(seed)
  sims <- MASS::mvrnorm(nsim, mu = b, Sigma = V)
  if (is.vector(sims)) sims <- matrix(sims, ncol = length(terms))
  comp_sim <- sweep(exp(sims) - 1, 2, p_vec, `*`)
  s_sim    <- rowSums(comp_sim)
  comp_est <- p_vec * (exp(b) - 1)
  s_est    <- sum(comp_est)
  q <- function(x, pr) unname(quantile(x, pr))
  tibble(component = c("Total", labels),
         HR  = c(NA_real_, exp(b)),
         PAF = c(s_est / (1 + s_est), comp_est / (1 + s_est)),
         lcl = c(q(s_sim / (1 + s_sim), 0.025), apply(comp_sim / (1 + s_sim), 2, q, 0.025)),
         ucl = c(q(s_sim / (1 + s_sim), 0.975), apply(comp_sim / (1 + s_sim), 2, q, 0.975)))
}

sg_prev_binary <- function(dat, var, ts, tp) {
  pt <- dat[[tp]] - dat[[ts]]
  x  <- dat[[var]]
  ok <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(pt)
  if (!any(ok)) return(NA_real_)
  sum(pt[ok][x[ok] == 1]) / sum(pt[ok])
}

sg_prev_factor <- function(dat, var, ts, tp) {
  pt    <- dat[[tp]] - dat[[ts]]
  x     <- dat[[var]]
  total <- sum(pt, na.rm = TRUE)
  setNames(vapply(levels(x), function(lv) sum(pt[x == lv], na.rm = TRUE) / total,
                  numeric(1)), levels(x))
}

# ----- Models 1-4: binary exposure -----
# For M4, hearing/vision get frailty_lag as a covariate; frailty uses the
# mutually adjusted Cox (as in the primary analysis).
build_rhs_14 <- function(model_id, exposure, gv) {
  drop <- drop_in_strata[[gv]]
  if (model_id == "M1") return(exposure)
  if (model_id == "M2") return(unique(c(exposure, setdiff("baseline_age", drop))))
  if (model_id == "M3") return(unique(c(exposure, setdiff(base_covs, drop))))
  if (model_id == "M4") {
    if (exposure == "frailty_lag")
      return(unique(c("hearing_lag", "vision_lag", "frailty_lag", setdiff(base_covs, drop))))
    return(unique(c(exposure, "frailty_lag", setdiff(base_covs, drop))))
  }
  stop("Unknown model_id: ", model_id)
}

paf_subgroup_14 <- function(data, exposure, time_vars, model_id, exposure_label) {
  map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(subgroup_specs)), function(k) {
    g  <- subgroup_specs$label[k]
    gv <- subgroup_specs$var[k]
    map_dfr(levels(droplevels(data[[gv]])), function(lv) {
      sub <- data %>% filter(.data[[gv]] == lv)
      p   <- sg_prev_binary(sub, exposure, time_vars[1], time_vars[2])
      fit <- fit_cox(sub, build_rhs_14(model_id, exposure, gv), time_vars)
      if (is.null(fit) || !(exposure %in% names(coef(fit))) || is.na(p) || p <= 0)
        return(tibble(model = model_id, exposure = exposure_label,
                      group = g, stratum = lv,
                      n_int = nrow(sub),
                      n_ev  = sum(sub[[time_vars[3]]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
                      p_pt = p, HR = NA_real_, PAF = NA_real_,
                      PAF_lcl = NA_real_, PAF_ucl = NA_real_))
      res <- sg_paf_ci_binary(fit, exposure, p)
      tibble(model = model_id, exposure = exposure_label,
             group = g, stratum = lv,
             n_int = fit$n, n_ev = fit$nevent,
             p_pt = p, HR = res$HR,
             PAF = res$PAF, PAF_lcl = res$lcl, PAF_ucl = res$ucl)
    })
  })
}

# ----- Model 5: 3-level ctx_lag -----
paf_subgroup_5 <- function(data, model_label, time_vars = m5_time) {
  map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(subgroup_specs)), function(k) {
    g  <- subgroup_specs$label[k]
    gv <- subgroup_specs$var[k]
    map_dfr(levels(droplevels(data[[gv]])), function(lv) {
      sub <- data %>% filter(.data[[gv]] == lv)
      sub$ctx_lag <- droplevels(sub$ctx_lag)
      cv  <- setdiff(base_covs, drop_in_strata[[gv]])
      fit <- fit_cox(sub, c("ctx_lag", cv), time_vars)

      empty <- function(n_int, n_ev)
        tibble(model = model_label, exposure = "Total", group = g, stratum = lv,
               n_int = n_int, n_ev = n_ev, p_pt = NA_real_, HR = NA_real_,
               PAF = NA_real_, PAF_lcl = NA_real_, PAF_ucl = NA_real_)
      if (is.null(fit))
        return(empty(nrow(sub), sum(sub[[time_vars[3]]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE)))

      terms        <- intersect(paste0("ctx_lag", levels(sub$ctx_lag)[-1]), names(coef(fit)))
      exposed_lvls <- sub("^ctx_lag", "", terms)
      p_exposed    <- sg_prev_factor(sub, "ctx_lag", time_vars[1], time_vars[2])[exposed_lvls]
      if (!length(terms) || any(is.na(p_exposed)) || any(p_exposed <= 0))
        return(empty(fit$n, fit$nevent))

      sg_paf_ci_multicat(fit, terms, p_exposed, exposed_lvls) %>%
        mutate(model = model_label,
               exposure = component,
               group = g, stratum = lv,
               n_int = fit$n, n_ev = fit$nevent,
               p_pt = c(sum(p_exposed), unname(p_exposed))) %>%
        dplyr::select(model, exposure, group, stratum, n_int, n_ev,
                      p_pt, HR, PAF, PAF_lcl = lcl, PAF_ucl = ucl)
    })
  })
}

# ============================================================================
# Run Models 1-4 by subgroup
# ============================================================================
paf_sg_14 <- bind_rows(lapply(c("M1", "M2", "M3", "M4"), function(m) bind_rows(
  paf_subgroup_14(tv_cc, "hearing_lag", tv_time, m, "Hearing loss"),
  paf_subgroup_14(tv_cc, "vision_lag",  tv_time, m, "Vision loss"),
  paf_subgroup_14(tv_cc, "frailty_lag", tv_time, m, "Frailty"))))

# ============================================================================
# Run Model 5 by subgroup (hearing context + vision context)
# ============================================================================
paf_sg_5 <- bind_rows(
  paf_subgroup_5(df_tv_hearing, "M5 (hearing context)"),
  paf_subgroup_5(df_tv_vision,  "M5 (vision context)")
)

# The M4 and M5 HRs here come from the same stratum fits as CHUNK 1
stopifnot(isTRUE(all.equal(
  paf_sg_14 %>% filter(model == "M4", exposure == "Hearing loss") %>% pull(HR),
  res_m4_hearing$HR, tolerance = 1e-8)))

# ============================================================================
# Combined subgroup PAF table
# ============================================================================
paf_subgroup_all <- bind_rows(paf_sg_14, paf_sg_5) %>%
  mutate(
    HR_fmt  = ifelse(is.na(HR), NA_character_, sprintf("%.2f", HR)),
    PAF_fmt = ifelse(is.na(PAF), NA_character_,
                     sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f%%, %.1f%%)",
                             100 * PAF, 100 * PAF_lcl, 100 * PAF_ucl))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(model, exposure, group, stratum,
                n_int, n_ev, p_pt, HR, HR_fmt,
                PAF, PAF_lcl, PAF_ucl, PAF_fmt)

cat("\n=== Subgroup PAF: Models 1-5 (ELSA) ===\n")
print(paf_subgroup_all, n = Inf)


# ============================================================================
# Combine Cox subgroup HRs + PAFs into one tidy table for forest plots
# ============================================================================
# ---- 1) Cox subgroup HRs in a common long format ---------------------------
tidy_m4 <- function(d, exposure_label) {
  d %>%
    transmute(model = "M4", exposure = exposure_label,
              group, stratum, n_int, n_ev,
              HR, HR_lcl = lo, HR_ucl = hi, p_int)
}

tidy_m5 <- function(d, ctx) {
  # ctx is "hearing" or "vision"; level 1 = before frailty onset,
  # level 2 = with or after frailty onset (matched by name in run_m5)
  d %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(HR_1, lo_1, hi_1, HR_2, lo_2, hi_2),
                 names_to = c(".value", "lvl"), names_pattern = "(HR|lo|hi)_(\\d)") %>%
    mutate(model    = paste0("M5 (", ctx, " context)"),
           exposure = if_else(lvl == "1", paste0(ctx, ", no frailty yet"),
                                          paste0(ctx, ", frailty present"))) %>%
    transmute(model, exposure, group, stratum, n_int, n_ev,
              HR, HR_lcl = lo, HR_ucl = hi, p_int)
}

hr_long <- bind_rows(
  tidy_m4(res_m4_hearing, "Hearing loss"),
  tidy_m4(res_m4_vision,  "Vision loss"),
  tidy_m4(res_m4_frailty, "Frailty"),
  tidy_m5(res_m5_hearing, "hearing"),
  tidy_m5(res_m5_vision,  "vision")
)

# ---- 2) PAF labels in the short form used by hr_long -----------------------
paf_join <- paf_subgroup_all %>%
  filter(model %in% c("M4", "M5 (hearing context)", "M5 (vision context)")) %>%
  mutate(exposure = case_when(
    grepl("^Hearing loss, ", exposure) ~ sub("^Hearing loss", "hearing", exposure),
    grepl("^Vision loss, ",  exposure) ~ sub("^Vision loss",  "vision",  exposure),
    TRUE ~ exposure)) %>%
  dplyr::select(model, exposure, group, stratum, n_int, n_ev,
                p_pt, PAF, PAF_lcl, PAF_ucl)

# ---- 3) Master long table (HR + PAF); M5 totals kept as PAF-only rows -------
forest_long <- hr_long %>%
  left_join(paf_join %>% dplyr::select(-n_int, -n_ev),
            by = c("model", "exposure", "group", "stratum")) %>%
  bind_rows(paf_join %>% filter(exposure == "Total") %>%
              mutate(HR = NA_real_, HR_lcl = NA_real_, HR_ucl = NA_real_,
                     p_int = NA_real_)) %>%
  mutate(
    HR_fmt  = ifelse(is.na(HR),  NA_character_,
                     sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", HR,  HR_lcl,  HR_ucl)),
    PAF_fmt = ifelse(is.na(PAF), NA_character_,
                     sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f%%, %.1f%%)",
                             100*PAF, 100*PAF_lcl, 100*PAF_ucl)),
    p_int_fmt = ifelse(is.na(p_int), NA_character_,
                       ifelse(p_int < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p_int)))
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(model, levels = c("M4", "M5 (hearing context)", "M5 (vision context)")),
          factor(exposure, levels = unique(c(hr_long$exposure, "Total"))),
          group, factor(stratum, levels = c(levels(tv_cc$age_cat), levels(tv_cc$sex_cat)))) %>%
  dplyr::select(model, exposure, group, stratum,
                n_int, n_ev, p_pt,
                HR, HR_lcl, HR_ucl, HR_fmt,
                PAF, PAF_lcl, PAF_ucl, PAF_fmt,
                p_int, p_int_fmt)

stopifnot(!anyNA(forest_long$PAF))   # every HR row found its PAF

cat("\n=== Combined subgroup HR + PAF (forest-plot ready) ===\n")
print(forest_long, n = Inf)

# ---- 4) Save everything in one place ---------------------------------------

subgroup_ELSA <- list(
  cox = list(m4_h = res_m4_hearing, m4_v = res_m4_vision, m4_f = res_m4_frailty,
             m5_h = res_m5_hearing, m5_v = res_m5_vision),
  paf    = paf_subgroup_all,
  forest = forest_long
)

saveRDS(subgroup_ELSA, file.path(results_dir, "subgroup_ELSA.rds"))
write.csv(forest_long,       file.path(results_dir, "subgroup_ELSA_forest.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(paf_subgroup_all,  file.path(results_dir, "subgroup_ELSA_paf.csv"),    row.names = FALSE)

```


# ELSA sensitivity analysis: exposures lagged by two waves (~4 years)
```{r}
# 1) Two-wave lag data
# ELSA waves are biennial -> 2 waves = 4 years on the (year - baseline_year)
# scale used for Models 1-5.
LAG_WAVES <- 2

# The primary interval build (tv_dat -> tv_cc) with lag(x, k) for the
# time-varying variables. k = 1 gives tv_cc back (checked below).
build_tv_wave_lag <- function(k) {
  out <- df0 %>%
    group_by(idauniq) %>%
    mutate(
      tstart      = lag(time),
      tstop       = time,
      event       = dementia,

      # status k assessed waves before the outcome wave
      exp_year    = lag(year, k),
      hearing_lag = lag(hearing_loss, k),
      vision_lag  = lag(vision_overall, k),
      frailty_lag = lag(frailty, k),

      emp_lag     = lag(Employment, k),
      smoke_lag   = lag(Smoking, k),
      alcohol_lag = lag(Alcohol, k)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(!is.na(tstart), tstop > tstart) %>%
    group_by(idauniq) %>%
    mutate(event_cum = cumsum(event)) %>%
    filter(event_cum <= 1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(-event_cum) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(hearing_lag), !is.na(vision_lag), !is.na(frailty_lag),
      !is.na(emp_lag),    !is.na(smoke_lag),  !is.na(alcohol_lag),
      !is.na(baseline_age),
      !is.na(Gender), !is.na(Race), !is.na(Education), !is.na(Marital_status)
    )
  stopifnot(!anyNA(out$event))
  out
}

# Frailty history at each wave, from every observed wave (as in
# build_m5_dataset(): recorded frail at this wave or any earlier one)
frail_history <- panel_df_eligible %>%
  mutate(
    idauniq        = as.character(idauniq),
    year          = as.integer(year),
    baseline_year = as.integer(baseline_year),
    time          = as.numeric(year - baseline_year),
    .frail        = as.integer(frailty)
  ) %>%
  arrange(idauniq, time) %>%
  group_by(idauniq) %>%
  mutate(frail_hist = cummax(coalesce(.frail, 0L))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, exp_year = year, frail_hist_exp = frail_hist)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(frail_history[c("idauniq", "exp_year")]))

# Model 5 data: sensory status and frailty history at the exposure wave
build_m5_wave_lag <- function(dat, sensory_lag, sensory_label) {
  out <- dat %>%
    left_join(frail_history, by = c("idauniq", "exp_year")) %>%
    mutate(
      start          = tstart,
      stop           = tstop,
      dementia_event = as.integer(event),
      sensory_exp    = as.integer(.data[[sensory_lag]]),
      ctx_num = case_when(
        sensory_exp == 0                       ~ 0L,
        sensory_exp == 1 & frail_hist_exp == 0 ~ 1L,
        sensory_exp == 1 & frail_hist_exp == 1 ~ 2L,
        TRUE                                   ~ NA_integer_
      ),
      ctx_lag   = factor(ctx_num, levels = 0:2, labels = m5_labels(sensory_label)),
      age_start = baseline_age + start
    )
  stopifnot(
    nrow(out) == nrow(dat),
    !anyNA(out$ctx_lag),
    all(out$frail_hist_exp[out$frailty_lag == 1] == 1),
    all(tapply(out$dementia_event, out$idauniq, sum) <= 1)
  )
  out
}

# ---- Checks against the main analysis ----------------------------------------
chk_key <- c("idauniq", "tstart", "tstop", "event", "hearing_lag", "vision_lag",
             "frailty_lag", "emp_lag", "smoke_lag", "alcohol_lag")
chk <- build_tv_wave_lag(1)
stopifnot(
  "lag(x, 1) does not reproduce tv_cc: rerun the primary data build" =
    nrow(chk) == nrow(tv_cc) &&
    isTRUE(all.equal(as.data.frame(chk[chk_key]), as.data.frame(tv_cc[chk_key]),
                     check.attributes = FALSE)),
  "Model 5 builder does not reproduce df_tv_hearing / df_tv_vision: rerun the primary Model 5 chunk" =
    identical(as.character(build_m5_wave_lag(chk, "hearing_lag", "Hearing loss")$ctx_lag),
              as.character(df_tv_hearing$ctx_lag)) &&
    identical(as.character(build_m5_wave_lag(chk, "vision_lag", "Vision loss")$ctx_lag),
              as.character(df_tv_vision$ctx_lag))
)
rm(chk, chk_key)

# ---- Analytic sample ---------------------------------------------------------
tv_cc_lag <- build_tv_wave_lag(LAG_WAVES)

sens_counts <- function(dat, label)
  cat(sprintf("%-30s intervals = %s | persons = %s | events = %s | person-years = %s\n",
              label,
              format(nrow(dat), big.mark = ","),
              format(n_distinct(dat$idauniq), big.mark = ","),
              format(sum(dat$event == 1), big.mark = ","),
              format(round(sum(dat$tstop - dat$tstart)), big.mark = ",")))

cat("\n=== Exposures lagged by", LAG_WAVES, "waves ===\n")
sens_counts(tv_cc,     "Main analysis (1-wave lag)")
sens_counts(tv_cc_lag, "Two-wave lag (tv_cc_lag)")

cat("\nYears from exposure wave to outcome wave (intervals):\n")
cat("  Main analysis:\n");  print(table(tv_cc$tstop - tv_cc$tstart))
cat("  Two-wave lag:\n")
print(table(tv_cc_lag$baseline_year + tv_cc_lag$tstop - tv_cc_lag$exp_year))


# ============================================================================
# 2) Models 1-5 on the two-wave lag data (formulas as in the main analysis)
# ============================================================================
fit_m1_hearing_lag <- coxph(
  Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~ hearing_lag + cluster(idauniq),
  data = tv_cc_lag, ties = "efron")
fit_m1_vision_lag <- coxph(
  Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~ vision_lag + cluster(idauniq),
  data = tv_cc_lag, ties = "efron")
fit_m1_frailty_lag <- coxph(
  Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~ frailty_lag + cluster(idauniq),
  data = tv_cc_lag, ties = "efron")

fit_m2_hearing_lag <- coxph(
  Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~ hearing_lag + baseline_age + cluster(idauniq),
  data = tv_cc_lag, ties = "efron")
fit_m2_vision_lag <- coxph(
  Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~ vision_lag + baseline_age + cluster(idauniq),
  data = tv_cc_lag, ties = "efron")
fit_m2_frailty_lag <- coxph(
  Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~ frailty_lag + baseline_age + cluster(idauniq),
  data = tv_cc_lag, ties = "efron")

fit_m3_hearing_lag <- coxph(
  Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~ hearing_lag +
    baseline_age + Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
    emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag + cluster(idauniq),
  data = tv_cc_lag, ties = "efron")
fit_m3_vision_lag <- coxph(
  Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~ vision_lag +
    baseline_age + Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
    emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag + cluster(idauniq),
  data = tv_cc_lag, ties = "efron")
fit_m3_frailty_lag <- coxph(
  Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~ frailty_lag +
    baseline_age + Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
    emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag + cluster(idauniq),
  data = tv_cc_lag, ties = "efron")

fit_m4_hearing_lag <- coxph(
  Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~ hearing_lag +
    baseline_age + Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
    emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag + frailty_lag + cluster(idauniq),
  data = tv_cc_lag, ties = "efron")
fit_m4_vision_lag <- coxph(
  Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~ vision_lag +
    baseline_age + Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
    emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag + frailty_lag + cluster(idauniq),
  data = tv_cc_lag, ties = "efron")
fit_m4_frailty_lag <- coxph(
  Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~
    hearing_lag + vision_lag + frailty_lag +
    baseline_age + Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status +
    emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag + cluster(idauniq),
  data = tv_cc_lag, ties = "efron")

cat("\n--- PH check, Model 4 (two-wave lag), global test ---\n")
print(rbind(
  hearing = cox.zph(fit_m4_hearing_lag)$table["GLOBAL", ],
  vision  = cox.zph(fit_m4_vision_lag)$table["GLOBAL", ],
  frailty = cox.zph(fit_m4_frailty_lag)$table["GLOBAL", ]
))

# ---- Model 5 -------------------------------------------------------------------
df_tv_hearing_lag <- build_m5_wave_lag(tv_cc_lag, "hearing_lag", "Hearing loss")
df_tv_vision_lag  <- build_m5_wave_lag(tv_cc_lag, "vision_lag",  "Vision loss")

fit_m5_hearing_lag <- fit_m5(df_tv_hearing_lag, "HEARING (two-wave lag)")
fit_m5_vision_lag  <- fit_m5(df_tv_vision_lag,  "VISION (two-wave lag)")

stopifnot(
  "Model 5 and Model 4 use different events" =
    fit_m5_hearing_lag$nevent == fit_m4_hearing_lag$nevent &&
    fit_m5_vision_lag$nevent  == fit_m4_hearing_lag$nevent
)

m5_tab_hearing_lag <- m5_category_table(fit_m5_hearing_lag, "HEARING (two-wave lag)")
m5_tab_vision_lag  <- m5_category_table(fit_m5_vision_lag,  "VISION (two-wave lag)")

m5_con_hearing_lag <- contrast_frailty_vs_no_frailty(fit_m5_hearing_lag, "HEARING (two-wave lag)")
m5_con_vision_lag  <- contrast_frailty_vs_no_frailty(fit_m5_vision_lag,  "VISION (two-wave lag)")
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 3) HR, P and Levin PAF 
#    sens_ helpers are copies of the primary PAF helpers, so a later chunk
#    that redefines paf_ci_binary() etc. cannot change these results.
# ============================================================================
sens_levin <- function(p, HR) (p * (HR - 1)) / (p * (HR - 1) + 1)

sens_prev_binary <- function(dat, var, ts, tp) {
  pt <- dat[[tp]] - dat[[ts]]
  x  <- dat[[var]]
  sum(pt[x == 1], na.rm = TRUE) / sum(pt, na.rm = TRUE)
}

sens_prev_factor <- function(dat, var, ts, tp) {
  pt    <- dat[[tp]] - dat[[ts]]
  x     <- dat[[var]]
  total <- sum(pt, na.rm = TRUE)
  setNames(vapply(levels(x), function(lv) sum(pt[x == lv], na.rm = TRUE) / total,
                  numeric(1)), levels(x))
}

sens_paf_binary <- function(fit, term, p, nsim = PAF_NSIM, seed = PAF_SEED) {
  b <- unname(coef(fit)[term])
  V <- vcov(fit)[term, term]                 # robust (cluster) variance
  stopifnot(!is.na(b), V > 0)
  set.seed(seed)
  sims <- rnorm(nsim, mean = b, sd = sqrt(V))
  pafs <- sens_levin(p, exp(sims))
  z    <- qnorm(0.975)
  tibble(
    HR      = exp(b),
    HR_lcl  = exp(b - z * sqrt(V)),
    HR_ucl  = exp(b + z * sqrt(V)),
    P       = summary(fit)$coefficients[term, "Pr(>|z|)"],
    PAF     = sens_levin(p, exp(b)),
    PAF_lcl = unname(quantile(pafs, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    PAF_ucl = unname(quantile(pafs, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE))
  )
}

sens_paf_multicat <- function(fit, terms, p_vec, labels,
                              nsim = PAF_NSIM, seed = PAF_SEED) {
  b <- unname(coef(fit)[terms])
  V <- vcov(fit)[terms, terms, drop = FALSE]
  set.seed(seed)
  sims <- MASS::mvrnorm(nsim, mu = b, Sigma = V)
  if (is.vector(sims)) sims <- matrix(sims, ncol = length(terms))
  HRs <- exp(sims)

  # Levin, partitioned so that components add up to the total
  comp_mat      <- sweep(HRs - 1, 2, p_vec, `*`)
  s_all         <- rowSums(comp_mat)
  paf_total_sim <- s_all / (1 + s_all)
  paf_comp_sim  <- comp_mat / (1 + s_all)

  HR_est    <- exp(b)
  se        <- sqrt(diag(V))
  comp_est  <- p_vec * (HR_est - 1)
  s_all_est <- sum(comp_est)
  z <- qnorm(0.975)
  q <- function(x, pr) unname(quantile(x, pr, na.rm = TRUE))

  tibble(
    component = c("Total", labels),
    HR      = c(NA_real_, HR_est),
    HR_lcl  = c(NA_real_, exp(b - z * se)),
    HR_ucl  = c(NA_real_, exp(b + z * se)),
    P       = c(NA_real_, summary(fit)$coefficients[terms, "Pr(>|z|)"]),
    PAF     = c(s_all_est / (1 + s_all_est), comp_est / (1 + s_all_est)),
    PAF_lcl = c(q(paf_total_sim, 0.025), apply(paf_comp_sim, 2, q, 0.025)),
    PAF_ucl = c(q(paf_total_sim, 0.975), apply(paf_comp_sim, 2, q, 0.975))
  )
}

# Check: the helpers give the main-analysis Model 4 hearing PAF exactly
ref <- paf_models_1_4 %>% filter(grepl("^M4", model), exposure == "Hearing loss")
chk <- sens_paf_binary(fit_m4_hearing, "hearing_lag",
                       sens_prev_binary(tv_cc, "hearing_lag", "tstart", "tstop"))
stopifnot(
  "PAF helpers do not reproduce the main-analysis PAF" =
    nrow(ref) == 1 &&
    isTRUE(all.equal(c(ref$HR, ref$PAF, ref$PAF_lcl, ref$PAF_ucl),
                     c(chk$HR, chk$PAF, chk$PAF_lcl, chk$PAF_ucl)))
)
rm(ref, chk)

# ---- Models 1-4 --------------------------------------------------------------
m14_spec <- tribble(
  ~model,    ~exposure,            ~fit,                 ~term,
  "Model 1", "Hearing impairment", "fit_m1_hearing_lag", "hearing_lag",
  "Model 1", "Vision impairment",  "fit_m1_vision_lag",  "vision_lag",
  "Model 1", "Frailty",            "fit_m1_frailty_lag", "frailty_lag",
  "Model 2", "Hearing impairment", "fit_m2_hearing_lag", "hearing_lag",
  "Model 2", "Vision impairment",  "fit_m2_vision_lag",  "vision_lag",
  "Model 2", "Frailty",            "fit_m2_frailty_lag", "frailty_lag",
  "Model 3", "Hearing impairment", "fit_m3_hearing_lag", "hearing_lag",
  "Model 3", "Vision impairment",  "fit_m3_vision_lag",  "vision_lag",
  "Model 3", "Frailty",            "fit_m3_frailty_lag", "frailty_lag",
  "Model 4", "Hearing impairment", "fit_m4_hearing_lag", "hearing_lag",
  "Model 4", "Vision impairment",  "fit_m4_vision_lag",  "vision_lag",
  "Model 4", "Frailty",            "fit_m4_frailty_lag", "frailty_lag"
)

paf_models_1_4_lag <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(m14_spec)), function(i) {
  fit <- get(m14_spec$fit[i]); term <- m14_spec$term[i]
  stopifnot(fit$n == nrow(tv_cc_lag))        # every model on the same rows
  p <- sens_prev_binary(tv_cc_lag, term, "tstart", "tstop")
  tibble(model = m14_spec$model[i], exposure = m14_spec$exposure[i], p_pt = p) %>%
    bind_cols(sens_paf_binary(fit, term, p))
}))

# ---- Model 5 -----------------------------------------------------------------
paf_model5_lag <- function(fit, label) {
  dat     <- attr(fit, "used")                 # rows the model used
  exposed <- levels(dat$ctx_lag)[-1]
  p_exp   <- sens_prev_factor(dat, "ctx_lag", "start", "stop")[exposed]
  terms   <- paste0("ctx_lag", exposed)
  stopifnot(all(terms %in% names(coef(fit))), all(p_exp > 0))
  tab <- sens_paf_multicat(fit, terms, p_exp, exposed)
  stopifnot(abs(sum(tab$PAF[-1]) - tab$PAF[1]) < 1e-10)   # components add up
  tab %>%
    transmute(model = label,
              exposure = ifelse(component == "Total", "Total context PAF", component),
              p_pt = c(sum(p_exp), unname(p_exp)),
              HR, HR_lcl, HR_ucl, P, PAF, PAF_lcl, PAF_ucl)
}

paf_m5_hearing_lag <- paf_model5_lag(fit_m5_hearing_lag, "Model 5 (hearing context)")
paf_m5_vision_lag  <- paf_model5_lag(fit_m5_vision_lag,  "Model 5 (vision context)")

# ---- Combined, formatted as in the supplement -------------------------------
paf_all_lag <- bind_rows(paf_models_1_4_lag, paf_m5_hearing_lag, paf_m5_vision_lag) %>%
  mutate(
    HR_CI  = ifelse(is.na(HR), "", sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", HR, HR_lcl, HR_ucl)),
    P_fmt  = ifelse(is.na(P), "", ifelse(P < 0.001, "P < 0.001", sprintf("P = %.3f", P))),
    PAF_CI = sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f to %.1f)", 100 * PAF, 100 * PAF_lcl, 100 * PAF_ucl)
  )

local({
  op <- options(width = 200); on.exit(options(op))
  cat("\n=== Supplementary Table 45 (ELSA): exposures lagged by two waves, Models 1-4 ===\n")
  print(as.data.frame(paf_all_lag %>% filter(!grepl("^Model 5", model)) %>%
                        dplyr::select(model, exposure, HR_CI, P_fmt, PAF_CI)),
        row.names = FALSE, right = FALSE)
  cat("\n=== Supplementary Table 46 (ELSA): exposures lagged by two waves, Model 5 ===\n")
  print(as.data.frame(paf_all_lag %>% filter(grepl("^Model 5", model)) %>%
                        dplyr::select(model, exposure, HR_CI, P_fmt, PAF_CI)),
        row.names = FALSE, right = FALSE)
})


# ============================================================================
# 4) How much of any change is the lag and how much the sample?
#    Model 4 with the one-wave and the two-wave lag on the same intervals
#    (two-wave lag rows that are also in tv_cc).
# ============================================================================
lag1_vals <- tv_cc %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, tstop, hearing_lag, vision_lag, frailty_lag,
                emp_lag, smoke_lag, alcohol_lag)
common_lag2 <- tv_cc_lag %>% semi_join(lag1_vals, by = c("idauniq", "tstop"))
common_lag1 <- common_lag2 %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(hearing_lag, vision_lag, frailty_lag, emp_lag, smoke_lag, alcohol_lag)) %>%
  left_join(lag1_vals, by = c("idauniq", "tstop"))

m4_rhs <- c(
  hearing_lag = "hearing_lag + frailty_lag",
  vision_lag  = "vision_lag + frailty_lag",
  frailty_lag = "hearing_lag + vision_lag + frailty_lag"
)
m4_on <- function(dat, term)
  coxph(as.formula(paste("Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~", m4_rhs[[term]],
                         "+ baseline_age + Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status",
                         "+ emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag + cluster(idauniq)")),
        data = dat, ties = "efron")
hr_line <- function(fit, term, label) {
  ci <- summary(fit)$conf.int
  tibble(exposure = term, analysis = label, intervals = fit$n, events = fit$nevent,
         HR_CI = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", ci[term, 1], ci[term, 3], ci[term, 4]))
}

m4_compare_lag <- bind_rows(lapply(names(m4_rhs), function(term) {
  stem <- sub("_lag$", "", term)
  bind_rows(
    hr_line(get(paste0("fit_m4_", stem)),           term, "Main analysis, all rows"),
    hr_line(m4_on(common_lag1, term),                term, "One-wave lag, common rows"),
    hr_line(m4_on(common_lag2, term),                term, "Two-wave lag, common rows"),
    hr_line(get(paste0("fit_m4_", stem, "_lag")),   term, "Two-wave lag, reported")
  )
}))

local({
  op <- options(width = 200); on.exit(options(op))
  cat("\n=== Model 4: one- vs two-wave lag ===\n")
  print(as.data.frame(m4_compare_lag), row.names = FALSE, right = FALSE)
})


# ---- Save for Supplementary Tables 45-46 and Supplementary Figs 12-13 --------
saveRDS(list(paf_all_lag   = paf_all_lag,
             m5_categories = list(hearing = m5_tab_hearing_lag, vision = m5_tab_vision_lag),
             m5_contrast   = list(hearing = m5_con_hearing_lag, vision = m5_con_vision_lag),
             m4_compare    = m4_compare_lag),
        file.path(results_dir, "lag2_sensitivity_ELSA.rds"))
write.csv(paf_all_lag, file.path(results_dir, "lag2_sensitivity_ELSA.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# 3) HR, P and Levin PAF (Supplementary Tables 47-48)
#    sens_ helpers: the same copies of the primary PAF helpers as in the
#    two-wave lag section, defined again so this section runs on its own.
# ============================================================================
sens_levin <- function(p, HR) (p * (HR - 1)) / (p * (HR - 1) + 1)

sens_prev_binary <- function(dat, var, ts, tp) {
  pt <- dat[[tp]] - dat[[ts]]
  x  <- dat[[var]]
  sum(pt[x == 1], na.rm = TRUE) / sum(pt, na.rm = TRUE)
}

sens_prev_factor <- function(dat, var, ts, tp) {
  pt    <- dat[[tp]] - dat[[ts]]
  x     <- dat[[var]]
  total <- sum(pt, na.rm = TRUE)
  setNames(vapply(levels(x), function(lv) sum(pt[x == lv], na.rm = TRUE) / total,
                  numeric(1)), levels(x))
}

sens_paf_binary <- function(fit, term, p, nsim = PAF_NSIM, seed = PAF_SEED) {
  b <- unname(coef(fit)[term])
  V <- vcov(fit)[term, term]                 # robust (cluster) variance
  stopifnot(!is.na(b), V > 0)
  set.seed(seed)
  sims <- rnorm(nsim, mean = b, sd = sqrt(V))
  pafs <- sens_levin(p, exp(sims))
  z    <- qnorm(0.975)
  tibble(
    HR      = exp(b),
    HR_lcl  = exp(b - z * sqrt(V)),
    HR_ucl  = exp(b + z * sqrt(V)),
    P       = summary(fit)$coefficients[term, "Pr(>|z|)"],
    PAF     = sens_levin(p, exp(b)),
    PAF_lcl = unname(quantile(pafs, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
    PAF_ucl = unname(quantile(pafs, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE))
  )
}

sens_paf_multicat <- function(fit, terms, p_vec, labels,
                              nsim = PAF_NSIM, seed = PAF_SEED) {
  b <- unname(coef(fit)[terms])
  V <- vcov(fit)[terms, terms, drop = FALSE]
  set.seed(seed)
  sims <- MASS::mvrnorm(nsim, mu = b, Sigma = V)
  if (is.vector(sims)) sims <- matrix(sims, ncol = length(terms))
  HRs <- exp(sims)

  # Levin, partitioned so that components add up to the total
  comp_mat      <- sweep(HRs - 1, 2, p_vec, `*`)
  s_all         <- rowSums(comp_mat)
  paf_total_sim <- s_all / (1 + s_all)
  paf_comp_sim  <- comp_mat / (1 + s_all)

  HR_est    <- exp(b)
  se        <- sqrt(diag(V))
  comp_est  <- p_vec * (HR_est - 1)
  s_all_est <- sum(comp_est)
  z <- qnorm(0.975)
  q <- function(x, pr) unname(quantile(x, pr, na.rm = TRUE))

  tibble(
    component = c("Total", labels),
    HR      = c(NA_real_, HR_est),
    HR_lcl  = c(NA_real_, exp(b - z * se)),
    HR_ucl  = c(NA_real_, exp(b + z * se)),
    P       = c(NA_real_, summary(fit)$coefficients[terms, "Pr(>|z|)"]),
    PAF     = c(s_all_est / (1 + s_all_est), comp_est / (1 + s_all_est)),
    PAF_lcl = c(q(paf_total_sim, 0.025), apply(paf_comp_sim, 2, q, 0.025)),
    PAF_ucl = c(q(paf_total_sim, 0.975), apply(paf_comp_sim, 2, q, 0.975))
  )
}

# Check: the helpers give the main-analysis Model 4 hearing PAF exactly
ref <- paf_models_1_4 %>% filter(grepl("^M4", model), exposure == "Hearing loss")
chk <- sens_paf_binary(fit_m4_hearing, "hearing_lag",
                       sens_prev_binary(tv_cc, "hearing_lag", "tstart", "tstop"))
stopifnot(
  "PAF helpers do not reproduce the main-analysis PAF" =
    nrow(ref) == 1 &&
    isTRUE(all.equal(c(ref$HR, ref$PAF, ref$PAF_lcl, ref$PAF_ucl),
                     c(chk$HR, chk$PAF, chk$PAF_lcl, chk$PAF_ucl)))
)
rm(ref, chk)

# ---- Models 1-4 --------------------------------------------------------------
m14_spec_red <- tribble(
  ~model,    ~exposure,            ~fit,                 ~term,
  "Model 1", "Hearing impairment", "fit_m1_hearing_red", "hearing_lag",
  "Model 1", "Vision impairment",  "fit_m1_vision_red",  "vision_lag",
  "Model 1", "Frailty",            "fit_m1_frailty_red", "frailty_lag",
  "Model 2", "Hearing impairment", "fit_m2_hearing_red", "hearing_lag",
  "Model 2", "Vision impairment",  "fit_m2_vision_red",  "vision_lag",
  "Model 2", "Frailty",            "fit_m2_frailty_red", "frailty_lag",
  "Model 3", "Hearing impairment", "fit_m3_hearing_red", "hearing_lag",
  "Model 3", "Vision impairment",  "fit_m3_vision_red",  "vision_lag",
  "Model 3", "Frailty",            "fit_m3_frailty_red", "frailty_lag",
  "Model 4", "Hearing impairment", "fit_m4_hearing_red", "hearing_lag",
  "Model 4", "Vision impairment",  "fit_m4_vision_red",  "vision_lag",
  "Model 4", "Frailty",            "fit_m4_frailty_red", "frailty_lag"
)

paf_models_1_4_red <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(m14_spec_red)), function(i) {
  fit <- get(m14_spec_red$fit[i]); term <- m14_spec_red$term[i]
  stopifnot(fit$n == nrow(tv_cc_red))        # every model on the same rows
  p <- sens_prev_binary(tv_cc_red, term, "tstart", "tstop")
  tibble(model = m14_spec_red$model[i], exposure = m14_spec_red$exposure[i], p_pt = p) %>%
    bind_cols(sens_paf_binary(fit, term, p))
}))

# ---- Model 5 -----------------------------------------------------------------
paf_model5_red <- function(fit, label) {
  dat     <- attr(fit, "used")                 # rows the model used
  exposed <- levels(dat$ctx_lag)[-1]
  p_exp   <- sens_prev_factor(dat, "ctx_lag", "start", "stop")[exposed]
  terms   <- paste0("ctx_lag", exposed)
  stopifnot(all(terms %in% names(coef(fit))), all(p_exp > 0))
  tab <- sens_paf_multicat(fit, terms, p_exp, exposed)
  stopifnot(abs(sum(tab$PAF[-1]) - tab$PAF[1]) < 1e-10)   # components add up
  tab %>%
    transmute(model = label,
              exposure = ifelse(component == "Total", "Total context PAF", component),
              p_pt = c(sum(p_exp), unname(p_exp)),
              HR, HR_lcl, HR_ucl, P, PAF, PAF_lcl, PAF_ucl)
}

paf_m5_hearing_red <- paf_model5_red(fit_m5_hearing_red, "Model 5 (hearing context)")
paf_m5_vision_red  <- paf_model5_red(fit_m5_vision_red,  "Model 5 (vision context)")

# ---- Combined, formatted as in the supplement -------------------------------
paf_all_red <- bind_rows(paf_models_1_4_red, paf_m5_hearing_red, paf_m5_vision_red) %>%
  mutate(
    HR_CI  = ifelse(is.na(HR), "", sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", HR, HR_lcl, HR_ucl)),
    P_fmt  = ifelse(is.na(P), "", ifelse(P < 0.001, "P < 0.001", sprintf("P = %.3f", P))),
    PAF_CI = sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f to %.1f)", 100 * PAF, 100 * PAF_lcl, 100 * PAF_ucl)
  )

local({
  op <- options(width = 200); on.exit(options(op))
  cat("\n=== Supplementary Table 47 (ELSA): reduced frailty index, Models 1-4 ===\n")
  print(as.data.frame(paf_all_red %>% filter(!grepl("^Model 5", model)) %>%
                        dplyr::select(model, exposure, HR_CI, P_fmt, PAF_CI)),
        row.names = FALSE, right = FALSE)
  cat("\n=== Supplementary Table 48 (ELSA): reduced frailty index, Model 5 ===\n")
  print(as.data.frame(paf_all_red %>% filter(grepl("^Model 5", model)) %>%
                        dplyr::select(model, exposure, HR_CI, P_fmt, PAF_CI)),
        row.names = FALSE, right = FALSE)
})


# ============================================================================
# 4) Main vs reduced index on the same intervals
#    Separates the effect of the index from the (small) change in rows.
# ============================================================================
m4_rhs_red <- c(
  hearing_lag = "hearing_lag + %s",
  vision_lag  = "vision_lag + %s",
  frailty_lag = "hearing_lag + vision_lag + %s"
)
m4_on_red <- function(term, frail_var) {
  rhs <- sprintf(m4_rhs_red[[term]], frail_var)
  coxph(as.formula(paste("Surv(tstart, tstop, event) ~", rhs,
                         "+ baseline_age + Gender + Race + Education + Marital_status",
                         "+ emp_lag + smoke_lag + alcohol_lag + cluster(idauniq)")),
        data = tv_cc_red, ties = "efron")
}
hr_text <- function(fit, term) {
  ci <- summary(fit)$conf.int
  sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", ci[term, 1], ci[term, 3], ci[term, 4])
}

m4_compare_red <- bind_rows(lapply(names(m4_rhs_red), function(term) {
  fit_main <- m4_on_red(term, "frailty_lag_full")
  fit_red  <- get(paste0("fit_m4_", sub("_lag$", "", term), "_red"))
  tibble(model    = "Model 4",
         exposure = term,
         main_index_same_rows = hr_text(fit_main, if (term == "frailty_lag") "frailty_lag_full" else term),
         reduced_index        = hr_text(fit_red, term))
}))

m5_compare_red <- bind_rows(lapply(c("hearing", "vision"), function(s) {
  invisible(capture.output(
    fit_main <- fit_m5(get(paste0("df_tv_", s, "_redrows_main")), s)))
  fit_red <- get(paste0("fit_m5_", s, "_red"))
  lv <- levels(attr(fit_red, "used")$ctx_lag)[-1]
  tibble(model    = paste0("Model 5 (", s, ")"),
         exposure = lv,
         main_index_same_rows = vapply(paste0("ctx_lag", lv), hr_text, "", fit = fit_main),
         reduced_index        = vapply(paste0("ctx_lag", lv), hr_text, "", fit = fit_red))
}))

local({
  op <- options(width = 200); on.exit(options(op))
  cat("\n=== Main (49-item) vs reduced (", n_items_reduced, "-item) index, same intervals ===\n", sep = "")
  print(as.data.frame(bind_rows(m4_compare_red, m5_compare_red)),
        row.names = FALSE, right = FALSE)
})


# ============================================================================
# 5) Describing the reduced index: item counts, score distribution,
#    frailty prevalence, agreement with the main index
# ============================================================================
cat("\n=== Items per wave (main / (I)ADL removed / reduced) and 80% cutoff ===\n")
print(as.data.frame(fi_item_counts), row.names = FALSE)

# Scores at baseline (persons in the analysis) and at the opening wave of
# every analytic interval
fi_scores_at_wave <- panel_red %>%
  transmute(idauniq, start_year = year,
            FI_full = fi_score, FI_reduced = fi_score_reduced,
            frail_full = as.integer(frailty),
            frail_reduced = as.integer(frailty_reduced))

fi_baseline_red <- panel_red %>%
  filter(year == baseline_year, idauniq %in% tv_cc_red$idauniq) %>%
  transmute(idauniq,
            FI_full = fi_score, FI_reduced = fi_score_reduced,
            frail_full = as.integer(frailty),
            frail_reduced = as.integer(frailty_reduced))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(fi_baseline_red$idauniq))

fi_intervals_red <- tv_cc_red %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, start_year, tstart, tstop) %>%
  left_join(fi_scores_at_wave, by = c("idauniq", "start_year"))
stopifnot(nrow(fi_intervals_red) == nrow(tv_cc_red))

dist_row <- function(x, index, level) {
  tibble(level = level, index = index,
         n = sum(!is.na(x)), missing = sum(is.na(x)),
         mean = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), sd = sd(x, na.rm = TRUE),
         median = median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
         q1 = unname(quantile(x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)),
         q3 = unname(quantile(x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)),
         min = min(x, na.rm = TRUE), max = max(x, na.rm = TRUE),
         pct_zero = 100 * mean(x == 0, na.rm = TRUE))
}
fi_distribution_red <- bind_rows(
  dist_row(fi_baseline_red$FI_full,     lab_main,    "Baseline (persons)"),
  dist_row(fi_baseline_red$FI_reduced,  lab_red, "Baseline (persons)"),
  dist_row(fi_intervals_red$FI_full,    lab_main,    "Interval opening waves"),
  dist_row(fi_intervals_red$FI_reduced, lab_red, "Interval opening waves")
)

pt <- fi_intervals_red$tstop - fi_intervals_red$tstart
fi_prevalence_red <- tibble(
  index = c(lab_main, lab_red),
  baseline_frail_n   = c(sum(fi_baseline_red$frail_full == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
                         sum(fi_baseline_red$frail_reduced == 1, na.rm = TRUE)),
  baseline_valid_n   = c(sum(!is.na(fi_baseline_red$frail_full)),
                         sum(!is.na(fi_baseline_red$frail_reduced))),
  baseline_frail_pct = 100 * baseline_frail_n / baseline_valid_n,
  intervals_frail_pct = 100 * c(mean(tv_cc_red$frailty_lag_full == 1),
                                mean(tv_cc_red$frailty_lag == 1)),
  person_time_frail_pct = 100 * c(sens_prev_binary(tv_cc_red, "frailty_lag_full", "tstart", "tstop"),
                                  sens_prev_binary(tv_cc_red, "frailty_lag", "tstart", "tstop"))
)

cohen_kappa <- function(a, b) {
  ok <- !is.na(a) & !is.na(b); a <- a[ok]; b <- b[ok]
  po <- mean(a == b)
  pe <- mean(a == 1) * mean(b == 1) + mean(a == 0) * mean(b == 0)
  (po - pe) / (1 - pe)
}
agree_row <- function(d, level) {
  ok <- !is.na(d$frail_full) & !is.na(d$frail_reduced)
  tibble(level = level, n = sum(ok),
         both_frail     = sum(d$frail_full[ok] == 1 & d$frail_reduced[ok] == 1),
         main_only      = sum(d$frail_full[ok] == 1 & d$frail_reduced[ok] == 0),
         reduced_only   = sum(d$frail_full[ok] == 0 & d$frail_reduced[ok] == 1),
         neither        = sum(d$frail_full[ok] == 0 & d$frail_reduced[ok] == 0),
         kappa          = cohen_kappa(d$frail_full, d$frail_reduced),
         pearson_r      = cor(d$FI_full, d$FI_reduced, use = "complete.obs"),
         spearman_rho   = cor(d$FI_full, d$FI_reduced, use = "complete.obs", method = "spearman"))
}
fi_agreement_red <- bind_rows(
  agree_row(fi_baseline_red,  "Baseline (persons)"),
  agree_row(fi_intervals_red, "Interval opening waves")
)

local({
  op <- options(width = 200); on.exit(options(op))
  cat("\n=== Frailty index score distribution ===\n")
  print(as.data.frame(fi_distribution_red), digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n=== Frailty prevalence (FI >= 0.25) ===\n")
  print(as.data.frame(fi_prevalence_red), digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n=== Agreement between the main and reduced index ===\n")
  print(as.data.frame(fi_agreement_red), digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
})

# Baseline score distribution, main vs reduced 
fig_fi_distribution_red <- fi_baseline_red %>%
  dplyr::select(idauniq, FI_full, FI_reduced) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(-idauniq, names_to = "index", values_to = "FI") %>%
  mutate(index = factor(index, levels = c("FI_full", "FI_reduced"),
                        labels = paste("Index:", c(lab_main, lab_red)))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(FI)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = FI)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.025, boundary = 0, fill = "grey60", colour = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.25, linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_wrap(~ index, ncol = 1) +
  labs(x = "Frailty index score at baseline", y = "Participants") +
  theme_classic()


# ---- Save for Supplementary Tables 47-48 and Supplementary Figs 14-15 --------
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "reducedFI_score_distribution_ELSA.png"), fig_fi_distribution_red,
       width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300)
saveRDS(list(paf_all_red   = paf_all_red,
             m5_categories = list(hearing = m5_tab_hearing_red, vision = m5_tab_vision_red),
             m5_contrast   = list(hearing = m5_con_hearing_red, vision = m5_con_vision_red),
             compare_main  = bind_rows(m4_compare_red, m5_compare_red),
             item_counts   = fi_item_counts,
             distribution  = fi_distribution_red,
             prevalence    = fi_prevalence_red,
             agreement     = fi_agreement_red),
        file.path(results_dir, "reducedFI_sensitivity_ELSA.rds"))
write.csv(paf_all_red, file.path(results_dir, "reducedFI_sensitivity_ELSA.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
